description: Aménagements cyclables programmés is a dataset listed in Plateforme Open Data Ville et Eurométropole de Strasbourg, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville et eurométropole de Strasbourg. Pour plus d'informations vous pouvez consulter la fiche de métadonnées. Ce jeu de données est mis à jour tous les trois mois. Coverage: Strasbourg Eurométropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transports. Its keywords are velo, amenagement, programme. The portal shows 449 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-strasbourg-eu-portal.
